_doc: Input to scripts/check-onboarding-write-doors.mjs. Design: docs/scoping/g1-write-door-check.md (PR #1189). gated = the doors the live guard check_organiser_onboarding_gate_v1() gates (names read from its body 2026-10-30). guard_allow_list = the guard's own allow-list (writes that are not event edits). expected_pending = a door the Website calls that the guard does NOT gate yet; each is a [WARN], never red; REMOVE the entry (and add the name to gated) once the admin gate migration (PR #1141) is applied. wrappers = the only files allowed to name a door, and which doors each may name. not_event_writes = write-shaped RPC names in src/ that are not event writes; a stale entry is red.
